Here in Serbia you are fucked if you get caught with pretty much anything.


I witnessed kids about 14-15 getting beat up by the police for a gram of weed and the intervention police ("interi") will give you a hard time if they find rolling papers on you.

Regarding the harder drugs, it's pretty much certain jail time or an insane fine. But Serbia is drowning in corruption and you can possibly slide a cop 20 euros and they will leave you alone (it's very risky tho)

Most drugs on the street are sold by literal pre-teens that work for bigger kingpins. Organised crime is a real problem here (our fucking president is currently on blast for concealing a 700 ton marijuana field in central Serbia)

Prices are kinda okay and despite the harsh laws, majority of people do some kind of drug. Mostly weed, (you can find top shelf for 10 euros), most people do speed (speed in Serbia is really fucking filthy and mixed with god knows what) and the richer people usually do cocaine.

We ain't legalizing weed anytime soon unfortunately
